title: Japanese Satay
description: A popular Japanese street food, this satay recipe is a fusion of Asian flavors and traditional Japanese ingredients. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a complete meal.
instructions: Brush satay with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill satay for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
While satay is cooking, combine peanut sauce, coconut milk, and green onions in a small saucepan.
Bring sauce to a simmer over medium heat and cook until slightly thickened.
To serve, place grilled satay on a plate and drizzle with peanut sauce.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over top and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
